title: The Prophet Agabus Predicts a Famine
description: In those days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch. One of them, Agabus, stood up and predicted by the Spirit that a severe famine would spread over the entire world. This happened during the reign of Claudius. The disciples in Antioch decided that each one should send relief to the brothers living in Judea according to their ability. They did so, sending their gift to the elders through Barnabas and Saul.
